title: Island Object Type
description: Physical definition of a type of object that can be found on an island, including how difficult it is to move, throw, or break.

id.description: [class-level] Stable identifier for the object type.

name.description: [class-level] Human-readable name of the object type.

movability.description: [class-level] How difficult the object is to move. 'fixed' means utterly difficult to move (e.g. a tree); 'trivial' means it can be carried with ease.

version.description: [class-level] Semantic version of the object type definition.

weightKg.description: Mass of a single instance in kilograms.

brittleness.description: Likelihood the object breaks when thrown or struck, from 0 (indestructible) to 1 (shatters easily).

throwable.description: Whether the object can be thrown by an agent.

stackable.description: Whether multiple instances can occupy the same space.

densityKgPerM3.description: Material density in kilograms per cubic meter.

notes.description: Authored commentary about the object type (not part of simulation state).
